name: Ro Darts [BETA]
desc:
🎯- This is just a simple darts game.

Features :

⚔️ - 1v1 against your friends
🤖 - 1v1 against an AI with different difficulty levels
🎯 - Practice mode
📦 - Skins

And more coming soon.

If you don't know how to play darts, don't worry, a tutorial is included.

Have fun !

Update log:
📱 - Mobile support added

⚠️WARNING: THIS IS A BETA, NEW FEATURES WILL BE ADDED AND YOUR PROGRESSION CAN BE RESET.⚠️
